name: Dagonet
subtitle: Jester Knight
description: Fool your foes as you lock their abilities and weaken their defenses whilst joining your allies in attacks.
lore: Elevated to knighthood by King Arthur, Dagonet served as jester and advisor more often than warrior, partly for his particular skills, but in part because he never seemed entirely stable. That madness has only grown since the Shattering, causing episodes of incomprehension—and more rarely, of murder. His king may have no choice but to take drastic steps, and soon.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when placing a [Debuff] on an enemy.

skills.name: Jester Dance
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 240%ATK, then attack 240%ATK each enemy under [DEF Down]. Each hit has a 50% chance to steal 1 random [Buff] from the target.

skills.name: Disappearing Act
skills.description: Place [mechanic:vanish] on this hero for 1 turn, then has a 75% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-i] on all enemies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Fools Courage
skills.description: When an enemy [Buff] activates or is removed, decrease 10% of their Turn Meter. When an enemy [Debuff] expires or is removed, decrease 10% of their Divinity.

skills.name: Opportunity Knocks
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 180%ATK with a 50% chance to place either [mechanic:lock-core] or [mechanic:lock-ultimate] on the target for 1 turn.
